title: Protocol and Orbit
author: Orsen Underhill
blurb: Ansel Eriksen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
